messages.subject: Greetings Wallace Users!
messages.body_plain:
At its foundation, this is a forum to ask and answer questions about the Wallace Ecological Modeling App, but it is also a space to discuss further collaborative development of the software, discuss topics related to the implementation of ecological modeling in R, and anything else you think is relevant.

Welcome, and please feel free to post any questions you'd like.
